providers.title: Classification of finite Euclidean Ramsey sets (OpenAI)
providers.scope: A set A of s >= 2 points with affine span R^d is Ramsey if and only if some matrix P over B = F (x)_Q F, F the coordinate field, satisfies (p_i (x) 1)^T P (1 (x) p_i) = 0 for all i and m_F(P_ab) = delta_ab on the spatial block. Proved in the eighth lesson.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Matrix condition and tensor condition
providers.scope: The matrix condition holds if and only if some symmetric tensor of affine functions over Q has (e_i (x) e_i)(T) = 0 at every point and gradient Gram matrix I_d.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The condition forces a sphere
providers.scope: A set satisfying the matrix condition lies on a sphere.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Colouring obstruction
providers.scope: If the tensor condition fails for A, then (2s+1)^s colours suffice to colour every R^D without a monochromatic congruent copy of A. The colouring uses Q-linear functionals chosen with Zorn's lemma.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Ramsey sets are spherical (Erdős, Graham, Montgomery, Rothschild, Spencer, Straus)
providers.scope: Every Ramsey set lies on a sphere. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Finite lattice identity
providers.scope: If a symmetric rational matrix C vanishes in every (Q^k/V_i) (x) (Q^k/V_i), there are finitely supported rational weights on Z^k with zero pushforward to every Z^k/Lambda_i, zero total weight and first moment, and second moment C.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Small negative curvature
providers.scope: If UCU^T = I_d, then for every eta > 0 some nonnegative smooth b with compact support has integral of (D_C b)_- |Ux|^2 below eta times the integral of b.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Two-scale configurations
providers.scope: Under the tensor condition, for every eta > 0 there are a congruent copy (f_i) of A and a copy (g_i) scaled by sqrt(q), q = eta/(1+eta), with each g_i a coordinate permutation of f_i.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Hales–Jewett theorem
providers.scope: For all k, r there is n such that every r-colouring of [k]^n has a monochromatic combinatorial line. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Ultrafilter space
providers.scope: The space of ultrafilters on a set is compact and Hausdorff. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: The corner group
providers.scope: For a monoid S there is an idempotent p in beta S such that p (beta S) p is a group with identity p.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Simultaneous realization
providers.scope: If B belongs to the products q_i1 ... q_iM of ultrafilters on strings for every row i, with columns common or principal, then strings, equal across rows in common columns, have their row products in B.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Path criterion
providers.scope: If for every n two paths in K^s have the same endpoint and weights lambda > 0, mu >= 0 with mu/lambda < 1/n, then A is Ramsey.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: A finite dimension
providers.scope: If every r-colouring of the space of finite sequences is constant on some congruent copy of A, then so is every r-colouring of some R^D.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Pair projections are groups
providers.scope: For i != j the projection of the correction monoid to the coordinates i, j is a group containing N x N, N the kernel of the exponent sum.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Equal endpoints
providers.scope: Two-scale configurations with ratio q give, for every delta > 0, two paths with a common endpoint and weight ratio at most q + s delta; with the path criterion this proves the sufficiency in the classification.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Subsets of transitive sets
providers.scope: Every nonempty subset of a finite transitive set is Ramsey. No hypothesis.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: At most five points on a circle
providers.scope: Every nonempty set of at most five points on a circle is Ramsey; in particular every cyclic quadrilateral and every triangle.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Kites outside transitive sets (Leader, Russell, Walters)
providers.scope: Four distinct concyclic points with w = z + alpha(x - z) + beta(y - z), alpha != 1 and beta transcendental over Q(alpha), lie in no finite transitive set.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Ramsey kites that are not subtransitive
providers.scope: For transcendental a in (-1, 1) the kite K_a is Ramsey and not subtransitive.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Nine generic points on a circle
providers.scope: Nine points of the unit circle with algebraically independent parameters do not form a Ramsey set.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review

providers.title: Three rotated squares
providers.scope: The twelve vertices of three squares on the unit circle, rotated by 0 and by plus or minus 2 arctan t with t a Liouville number, do not form a Ramsey set.
providers.status: proof written in the course; self-checked by the writing AI; no independent review
